title: Digital Computer Newsletter, volume 10 number 3
lineage: Contemporary Navy newsletter reports Rosenblatt’s perceptron simulations on an IBM 704, Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory, and an Office of Naval Research contract. It says dedicated hardware remained about a year from completion; broad claims about autonomy are promotional.
